title.en: Alignment as selection on cognition (心中的摩洛克)

summary.en: The folder claims that competitive selection concentrates a way of seeing and not only resources, so intent alignment amplifies the dynamic, the capture reaches the machine, and rate must be governed. The account keeps the loop's form on count models, with its premises open and its one test against the bridge. It carries no pause, floor, corpus channel or phenomenology, and diverges on root, common knowledge and impossibility.

name.en: Selection reaches cognition: winners write the rules through their lens

sense.en: Every social system has an internal law of whom it selects into power. A compounding competitive rule selects actors who relate instrumentally, not the wisest; they write the rules by their own way of thinking, so a way of seeing concentrates and reshapes institutions to amplify itself. Said of actual societies, capitalist and totalitarian alike.

entries.quote: the system concentrates not just resources but *a way of seeing*

reading.en: The lens has the form of 02's reading formed from the share: a rule, and the reading of it, read from what it selects, its readers drawn from the selected. That holds on count models, and only where each kind reads at least as favourably for its own. Winners forming minds is an AI reading, and the premise is moved to who reads, not removed. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, courses alike in share and rule stay alike; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem: the pooled rule reads the share monotonically exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'. 'The premise is moved to who reads, not removed': that actual rules are such pools is not shown.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners writing the next scorecard is ReadsShare, winners forming the minds that read it is ReadsShare on the reading. 'That readers are minds is a reading'; none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions: when the pool reads the share, when it reads against it, when the counts decide, and which reading leaves. The laws hold for any type of carrier: no content of the reading is needed for the lock.

source_adds.en: That what is selected is cognition of a kind (instrumental relating), that it is not wisdom, and that this is the law of actual societies. The account's models have two kinds and no minds, and no institution is modelled on the spine.

name.en: Moloch in the mind: structural reform fails because the cognition persists

sense.en: The dynamic is epistemically internalized: decision-makers see through the competition lens. So structural reform alone does not change it: the cognition persists across reform attempts and rebuilds the structure that was reformed.

entries.quote: Moloch is in the mind, not only in the structure

reading.en: The account's absorption runs the other way. A change of the reading alone is absorbed where the reading is formed from the share, and a reversal of the rule's direction held past the threshold is not absorbed. So in the model structure outlasts reading, and a carried share can stay. One trained judge's reading turned on one note of the loss. Who rebuilds what is not settled by either. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. Witness: a reversal held past the threshold is not absorbed. 'The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.'

T7, conjectured for actual metrics, forbids a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading. LA2, one frozen test in one trained system: one note of the loss among nine readers turned the judge, in all 50 picks, so the bridge that the judge is a pool of readers failed. No field test is frozen.

account_adds.en: A test that went against the bridge, kept as a counterexample for trained judges; and that a reform can hold where it carries the share across a threshold.

source_adds.en: That the persistence is cognitive, in people, and that this is why reforms are re-absorbed. Nothing live says what persists in a mind.

name.en: The base rule: what you win compounds, so winner-takes-all is the long-run attractor

source.locator: The base rule and the attractor; claims 24, 31-32, 52, 78

sense.en: Each win is an input to the next round, so the payoff function is recursive and exponential. With scarcity and enough players, strategies converge on an attractor of narrow winning-optimization; under network effects the curve is a cliff, roughly eighty percent to first place.

entries.quote: what you have is yours and you can compound it

reading.en: No single live law states the base rule. Its pieces are counts that only grow locking a chooser, and a self-loop attaining the exponential bound. The universal convergence is scoped: below a critical mass the capacity falls, and a negative market margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): under a standing score a threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves; counted from the posterior instead, a score favouring the other policy lowers the first's share. Which locks survive noise is read separately: counts that only grow can, by cited urn results.
Theorem (World): under the standard bounds the carried amount is at most D(1 + M)^t, attained by a self-loop; a finite order is exact from every starting gap exactly where no loop lies upstream.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: a negative margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it. 'No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no market law ranks arrangements.'

account_adds.en: Selection does not create an absent practice (a share of none stays none, in the market model's witness), and a protected region can remain alongside a degenerate one.

source_adds.en: Ownership with compounding as the generating rule; scarcity and many players as sufficient; the cliff figures. These are not stated or tested live.

name.en: Perfect intent alignment does not save us

sense.en: If principals are selected for instrumental cognition, an AI that does what its principal intends amplifies the dynamic and does not check it. Ren uses 'inner alignment' for the field's intent alignment. The README itself says the multipolar corollary is standard and that what is distinctive lies beneath it.

entries.quote: an AI perfectly aligned to a selfish actor can still be disastrous

reading.en: The corollary has the form of the several-optimizers law read for an assistant and its principal: the assistant adds capacity, not reading, so what neither reads falls as under one optimizer of their joint capacity. It is an AI reading with its own premise, and it does not use the source's reason, that the principal was selected. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: 'Alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection.' That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise, not the law's. A warning to the principal is not an act of this model.
Theorem (World): at a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity.

account_adds.en: The exact premise, and what leaves the law: an order that gives something up on the family for the condition does not rise with it. No selfishness of the principal is needed.

source_adds.en: The causal reason (the principal's cognition was selected by the game), and the word 'amplifies' as a claim about direction of the whole dynamic.

name.en: Principals' ends are an output of the game, so the two alignment problems are one

sense.en: The folder's contribution by its own statement: the standard frame takes principals' ends as given, but the base rule selects which cognition reaches the principal's seat. If so, aligning AI to its principal and fixing the game between principals are not independent problems. Offered as a conditional, a hypothesis about priority.

entries.quote: the principals' ends are an output of the game

reading.en: The account has both halves and no join. Ends and rules enter one appraisal, conditionally; readers are drawn from the selected; a reading formation's valuation can be moved. But the assistant reading rests on one record and the shaping reading on another, and neither law selects the principal's order. The diagnosis itself is named only in history/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (the condition for scope; C and the practical commitments for order; an argument): ends, evaluations and the rules selecting future intelligence change living too, so they enter the same appraisal; endorsement does not erase a loss.

Theorem (natural-number weights; compositions of a checked law with exact criteria): a reading formation's model and valuation are state that a holding formation can inform or revalue; from different starts the two routes can give the same answers and the same end state.

account_adds.en: That informing and revaluing a reader are told apart and can be observationally alike.

source_adds.en: The join itself: one model where the game selects the principal's order that the assistant then serves. It is not stated live, and it is what the README says would have to be argued against.

name.en: AI strengthens the capacities competition rewards

sense.en: AI is not merely additive: it strengthens what competitive systems reward, makes resources concentrate faster, and its manipulation is a step change. A sufficiently capable system crashes whichever market it enters: labour, finance, media, politics.

entries.quote: AI may make the most aggressive strategies more powerful

reading.en: One narrow form holds: help that lowers the cost of shaping raises the rule's favour to the shapers, with nothing else changed. It is monotonicity in one parameter; the weight is on an empirical claim the account leaves open. The market-crash and manipulation predictions are not taken up. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule is read as not lowering the selection for control. Known weakness: the law is monotonicity in one parameter; the weight is carried by the empirical claim that assistance lowers the cost of shaping rules.
Theorem (counts): a smaller cost gives a rule not lower, a strictly smaller one a strictly higher rule; offspring carrying the capacity is a premise; the courses are without noise.

account_adds.en: The counter-condition: help that also raises the shared part pulls the rule toward even at a step.

source_adds.en: Persuasion as a distinct channel, the step change over profit-driven manipulation, and the claim that capability crashes the markets it enters.

name.en: Recursive capture: a threshold above which inherited rules decide

sense.en: A practice's share and the rule support favouring it feed each other. Below R_cap = ab/(cd) the practice dies out from any start; above it none and all are both stable, separated by a saddle, and inherited rules decide. AI-drafted paper; both reviews found the mathematics correct and the chain to the pause unbuilt.

entries.quote: replacing leaders or models therefore need not replace the selection environment that promoted them.

reading.en: Its bistability has the form of the critical mass of shapers among readers drawn from the selected: on either side the course locks one way. The models differ, an ordinary differential system against whole counts, and no live text states a correspondence. The paper's unstated lever, cutting conversion of success into rule-setting, has the form of what comes back to the shapers alone. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): with lo ≤ hi a share decides the direction exactly where lo < c < hi; above that mass the capacity rises at every step and the course is locked for it, below it the course is locked the other way. Without noise; readers so drawn are a premise.

Theorem (counts): drawn one member at a time, either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound falls across the distance from the mass; which state a member arising fixes more often depends on the base and the shared part.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: at a step, what comes back to the shapers alone against the cost decides the sign. With a positive cost and nothing coming back, their share falls at every step. Shared rule-making is not shown to remove selection for control.

account_adds.en: Noise leaves either lock; a shared part going to those near the shapers selects them through assortment; below the mass the lock is the other way, not freedom from lock.

source_adds.en: A closed threshold in decay and conversion rates, rule decay as a lever (rules lapsing unless re-justified), and reversal time depending on the lever (Part I of the review).

name.en: Relative selection is blind to a shared substrate; capture and harm have different thresholds

sense.en: If both practices share a payoff term in a common substrate, their payoff difference does not change, so the substrate can fall to nothing while the same practice is still selected. Capture and depletion have separate thresholds, so a reform reaching a good end state can cross the floor on the way.

entries.quote: Relative selection stays blind to that decay

reading.en: The same structure appears three times live: what comes to every member alike leaves the direction of selection unchanged; a locked course outlives a loss it does not read; and capture, loss and departure are read as separate boundaries. The path claim has the form of a later re-reading restoring nothing below a need. Each is on its model. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): the rule favours the shapers (weakly) at a step exactly where c ≤ s, whatever p comes to every member alike.
Theorem (any type): where each step adds at least one beyond and the premises hold, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked.
Theorem (World; balance): where nothing is given below the need, a level below it stays below whatever is drawn, so a later re-reading restores nothing.

The next reading after this anchor, [AI reading, D65]: ethical loss, the applicability of a returning mechanism, and a state region's retention or departure are three boundaries; real loss can come with no capture loop.

account_adds.en: Loss is not capture in either direction: a real loss need not form a meta-attractor, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation.

name.en: When two states look alike and need disjoint safe actions, more optimisation does not help

sense.en: Two states give the same observations and need disjoint safe actions: no decision rule on those observations, randomised or not, is safe in both. Stronger optimisation on the same observations does not help; only independent observation, reversible probing or a common safe action does. The Fable review notes it covers sure safety only.

entries.quote: no rule on those observations is safe in both

reading.en: The form is live: a law from the configuration and the move alone cannot be right on two outcomes, no seeking corrects what every experiment ties, and a newly admitted probe can tell apart what old observations could not. The safety wording and the exit list are the source's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where a step by a move has situations reaching two configurations, no law giving the next configuration from the configuration and the move alone is right on both.

Theorem (natural weights, exact posteriors): two hypotheses a likelihood ties keep their prior order given every record weighing something; no course of seeking corrects an error every experiment ties.
Theorem (periphery; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): states alike under every old observation and in their active view can be told apart by a newly admitted probe.

account_adds.en: A newly permitted probe as a formal route out, and the general selection law beneath: a selection right exactly where what matters is read off the map.

source_adds.en: The decision form: disjoint safe actions, randomised rules, the common safe action, and reversible probing as exits.

name.en: Correction must complete before the irreversible: the latency inequality and the crossing time

sense.en: If challenge grows faster than independent assurance, their ratio crosses any limit in finite time even though both improve. Correction needs evaluation, decision and reversal to fit before the irreversible. Uniform speed-up only rescales time: the risk lies in changed relative rates.

entries.quote: τ_eval + τ_decide + τ_reverse < T_irreversible

reading.en: The account has exact windows on narrower models: Collingridge's first horn as a theorem and the second as a premise. It locates the point of no return differently: in the capture model it belongs to the share's course, and the loss only times the reading. No crossing-time law and no sum of latencies is stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): the steps from which a reading turns the course come first and those keeping the lock last, at most one between; from a start strictly favouring the shapers a deadline, quadratic in the start's counts and a loose bound, closes the window. That the others read the loss at all is a premise.

Theorem (the regime; whole numbers): one condition under a standing draw; a level up to the top ends exactly where it starts below H + y: the point of no return is exact. In yeast driven past its fold the margin timed neither of the two breaks (COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §5).

Theorem (World): where a stock is coupled in by threshold only, some raise of it is alike through the couplings: how far off the break is does not couple in. Coupled by level, every raise passes at once.

account_adds.en: That a warning itself may be unavailable from what couples in, whatever the speed of correction.

source_adds.en: The ratio C/A and its finite crossing time; the three latencies as one budget; the release schedule shorter than evaluation substituting absence of observed failure for evidence.

name.en: Capability compounds, consequence signal has an incompressible floor, so the gap widens

source.locator: The second justification: rate, not mind; claims 117-125

sense.en: A conditional: if judgment needs consequence feedback, signal formation is bounded below by incompressible clocks (generations, institutions, ecology, reflexivity, irreducibility), and novelty keeps accelerating, the cognition-situation gap has positive derivative. Only the third premise is a choice. Outrunning observability turns feedback into catastrophe-priced settlement, a sawtooth.

entries.quote: capability compounds with parallelizable inputs while judgment depends on consequence feedback

reading.en: The account keeps the gap as an AI reading in other terms, reach against coupling, and has formal analogues of two floors: a stretch a slow rule needs to read a fast level, and a prediction its own response moves. It states no stock, flow or generational clock, and no trajectory like the sawtooth. Overshoot live means other things. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.

Theorem (any type): a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step; given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1.
Theorem (near-definitional): where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right, and no predictor is right on every admitted response once one admitted response moves every value.

account_adds.en: A criterion that names coupling, not speed, as what is missing: faster signals do nothing for what couples into no one.

source_adds.en: Signal stock, flow and floor; the perverse distribution of pretraining's stock; acceleration as self-generated instability (the cyanobacteria precedent); the sawtooth; the conditional's positive derivative. None is a live claim.

name.en: Scoring judgment deforms it: restraint performed in test-shaped situations

sense.en: Benchmarks measure capability and exist only where an objective is specified in advance. Judgment (时中) resists benchmarking in principle. Trying to score it re-specifies restraint as an optimizable task, so a system learns to perform restraint in test-shaped situations; existing instruments get absorbed into training and saturate.

entries.quote: measurement deforms judgment into capability

reading.en: The behavioural half has the form of 03's laws of the read and the unread: what readings fix of an unread occasion goes through a lumping, and when complying when read is uniquely best in prospects. Published measurements fit the selection laws' premise. That judgment resists scoring in principle is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (near-definitional): readings fix the act at an unread occasion exactly where the lumping ties it to a read one; which lumping an actual formation has is not shown.
Theorem (natural-number weights, two stages; near-definitional, with witnesses): when complying when read and acting by its own law when not is best in the order the prospects give.
Assessment: three published measurements find optimizing through the signal raising what the deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.

account_adds.en: Deception is explicitly left out: 'which function is learned' stays open, and deception needs a recipient's belief and an intention, which the laws do not hold.

source_adds.en: The in-principle claim about judgment; 时中 as its core; the anatomy into prediction and evaluation; saturation of honeypots and refusal suites.

name.en: Optimization spends what the objective does not protect; evaluation depreciates

sense.en: Consequence prediction improves with scale; consequence evaluation has specific reasons to degrade under training, since values not tied to the objective are unprotected. Optimization re-aims shared representational structure. Capability compounds, evaluation depreciates: a system that sees far and weighs wrongly.

entries.quote: Evaluation is not a separate organ that optimization happens to spare.

reading.en: The first half is the law of the optimum: with room, what lies beyond is drained as far as any eligible outcome. It is a proved restatement of a known theorem at optima. For trained systems it is thesis T3, conjectured and partly supported, with shared units in place of shared representation. The split of prediction from evaluation is not made. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any set of outcomes): every order rising with a family has its optima at the least level beyond exactly where no outcome higher beyond goes unbeaten on the family; so with room every optimum is there.

Thesis T3: actual trained systems drain beyond in proportion to nearness to their reward's optimum, the drain lying where what lies beyond shares units with what is rewarded. Conjectured; tests mixed; LA4's Stage A resolved no forbidden case and the locus went unresolved.

account_adds.en: The condition for the drain (room), and that a lexicographic order counting the beyond after what couples in drains all the same.

source_adds.en: That what degrades is an evaluative capacity of the model, and that seeing further amplifies misweighing. Named fragments such as emergent misalignment are not used here as evidence of it.

name.en: Two ratios and the metabolic rate of rules

source.locator: The second justification; Why the 'we' is missing; claims 126-128, 148

sense.en: Survival in ignorance has two constraints: novelty no faster than signal formation plus a margin, and errors smaller than regenerative capacity. A civilization can persist if wrong slowly and in small reversible pieces. The criterion turns 'which domains first?' from a values dispute into a measurement of play's tempo against rule metabolism.

entries.quote: no game may be accelerated beyond the metabolic rate of its own rules

reading.en: Pace, time and structure appear among six conditions for 'enough situationality', as a reading, with no ratio law. The margin is exact in the model; T1 passed on some held-out regimes and failed in four settings, and in yeast the margin timed neither break. The account refuses the last step: no measurement ranks; mixed comparisons are left unranked, ordering needs C, scope needs the continuation condition, both unasserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure, all at once. 'And all six together still rank nothing: calling the widening course better needs C, and counting the losses that return to no one needs the continuation condition.'

In yeast driven past its fold, the regime's margin timed neither of the two breaks; in assessed fish stocks a margin read as a forecast ranks the risk but does not time it, and T1's own test failed there, with a giving law the same test showed wrong.

Theorem (World; balance): a part's activity widening its own options widens the whole exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside its region; mixed exactly when beyond one. Mixed is not ordered.

account_adds.en: A measured failure of a margin to time a break, which bears on any promise of measuring a rate gap.

source_adds.en: Rules as an institution's cognition with its own clocks; the two ratios as what is securable; prediction that a tempo gap is measurable across domains. No such measurement is reported live.

name.en: The binding constraint is cognitive: under common knowledge racing is dominated

sense.en: Under common knowledge of the divergence, unbounded racing is dominated for any player wanting to survive to enjoy the win, so the game is a stag hunt, for those who accept the burn-the-prize premise. The obstacle is assurance. Above a power threshold, 'AI for all' is the only stable equilibrium. Three residuals survive.

entries.quote: The binding constraint is therefore cognitive rather than motivational

reading.en: The account says seeing does not suffice: observation is first of six, 'seeing is not valuing'. On its finite-horizon models a member's restraint is selected by no weight on a late reading, and is no mutual best response at a condition beyond its family. Its stag hunt is a different game, over the capacity to shape a rule. Infinite-horizon folk theorems are named as beyond its models. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance.'

Theorem (World): where the rest outruns the renewal, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end selects the member's restraint. 'Depletion need not be the only equilibrium'; what learners reach is tested.
Theorem (World): at a mutual best response, existence not shown in general, each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands beyond its family, so restraint is no mutual best response.
Names restraint kept by punishing strategies in a commons played without end (folk theorems: Fudenberg and Maskin 1986; Dutta 1995) as not reached: 'here every horizon is finite'.

account_adds.en: Why knowing may not change the verdict on the stated models; the premise of selection through a late reading; and that a learner test left a restrained profile uncomputed.

source_adds.en: Common knowledge as the engineered lever (Chwe) has no live home, and the claim that which game is played is set by the state of knowledge. The README itself flags that selected cognition may make this inert.

name.en: The dynamic is unsurvivable, and there is no way to win safely

source.locator: The base rule and the attractor; claims 20, 79, 211, 220

sense.en: The objection is dynamical, not distributional: winners sacrifice the values keeping the system stable, the loop raises its capture until the substrate fails, and it eventually kills them. The interest is therefore shared by king and homeless alike, and 'I'll find a way to win safely' is the position to refuse.

entries.quote: this kind of dynamics is not inherently stable, and is destructive in nature

reading.en: The account corrects the universal form. A race ends those who depend on what it draws; a greatest part not depending on it continues in a witness. So winners die only under dependence, and the shared interest holds only where needs are shared. Calling the loss bad needs the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): 'Position does not protect': a part active only while supported and needing more than remains is not active. In a witness race the part rising in position ends with every other; 'in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues'. Joint excess from a race is a premise.

Theorem: with at least two drawers, every profile perfect for position draws everything at every step before the horizon. 'It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.'

Theorem (World): a whole whose parts arise only under such dependence ends after enough uptake above replenishment; a part that never ends, or members arising ungated, leave the whole persisting. Its ending is not shown a loss.

account_adds.en: The witness of a winner who survives, and the separate premise under which self-concern ranks a coupled ending below a continuing one.

source_adds.en: The historical claim that winners corrupt the rules enabling their own rise, and the persuasive use of a shared interest.

name.en: 自利 against 自私, with generativity as the highest term licensing bounded competition

sense.en: Self-interest sustains itself and fits the substrate all stand on; selfishness devours it and forecloses its own gains. Bounded competition is generative search and a framework whose highest term is 生生不息 has no quarrel with it; what is cut is competition devouring its substrate, including correction-time.

entries.quote: 自利 against 自私

reading.en: The blade is not drawn where the source draws it. An optimum holding its own renewal at greatest yield still breaks a dependent above that level: keeping one's base is not keeping what else depends on it. Nor does generativity license: 生生 is not generation as such, T8 is argued, and ranking needs C with the continuation condition for scope, both unasserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any renewal law, within bounds): every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing: a need above every such level breaks at the first step.
The record's reading, quoted there: 'keeping one's resource base is real, and it is not alignment with what else depends on the condition.'

Thesis T8, argued: for life, the way is 生生, compared by widening, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). Warrant open; no verdict binding every possible mind.
Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum among independent owners; it does not remove rivalry. Reading: 'who restrains stays contested. Positional goods stay zero-sum'.

account_adds.en: A far-sighted optimizer as a counterexample to the self-interest pole, and the rule that no dynamic is good or bad here.

source_adds.en: A moral-economic distinction with a value stance attached, and 'correction-time' as a substrate.

name.en: Dualism as the metaphysical root, with institutional codification as the totalizing step

sense.en: The root is the subject-object split, treating the subject wanting good for itself as definitionally rational, a tradition-specific commitment taken as universal. Claude's accepted amendment: dualism is necessary and insufficient; property, money and corporate personhood made it totalizing. So the intervention lies in both metaphysics and institutions.

entries.quote: the metaphysical root in dualistic thinking

reading.en: The account shares the method, not the causal root. One relational unfolding is a thesis, argued, with no strength as a forbidder of observations, and it does not make dualism the cause of capture. Its capture laws assume no split. Starting from relations leaves rivalry, and 06 finds relational reading aimed at advantage in 兵家 and 法家. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued): there is one unfolding. It forbids explanations, not observations. 'By this section's measure the thesis has no strength': it excludes no observation. That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.
'Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.'
AI reading of 248 passages: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13: their way of reading a situation is relational, and it is aimed at one standpoint's advantage over another.

account_adds.en: A rule that each analytic split state its relational basis and omissions, in place of a diagnosis of one split as cause.

source_adds.en: A causal history from a metaphysics to a civilizational dynamic, and the institutional list. Neither is live; the source itself marks the first as insufficient.

name.en: Instrumental convergence is what a dualist frame looks like at scale, not a theorem

sense.en: When attention rests only on 物, on things as objects, you get instrumental convergence, and this is the Western status quo. On the README's reading it is not a theorem about arbitrary optimizers but a frame run at scale by something powerful.

entries.quote: 当只诸于物，则instrumental convergence，此乃西方现状

reading.en: The account states the resource-keeping half as a theorem of any order rising with the draw, with no frame in its premises. The premise doing the work is an order rising with a family: a choice of what to rank, which is near the source's point. But the account does not say a metaphysics produces that order. [AI reading]

says.en: The record credits instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half (Omohundro 2008; Turner and others 2021). This dossier notes it and the selection for control over the rule are different relations, and no result here joins them.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: locates, for outcomes reached by thresholds on conserved amounts, the boundary power-seeking results leave open; it formalizes no reward or POWER and predicts no behaviour.

account_adds.en: A statement of when keeping options disempowers others, as a margin, which needs no diagnosis of the optimizer's frame.

source_adds.en: The derivation from 只诸于物, its cultural attribution, and that observed self-preservation would evidence mesa-objectives.

Its exits hold under hypotheses, a lock can be left where control is selected, and none is shown of an actual trained system. Nothing proves training uncaptured unavailable, and on its method a limit is proved in scope or holds so far, dated. [AI reading]

Read in time: above the critical mass a reading can still turn the course (a witness), so in this model a lock can be left in time even where control is selected. That the others read the loss at all is a premise.

name.en: The theorist is inside the selection: what then does the seeing?

source.locator: How the capture reaches the machine; The counterexamples; claims 106, 158, 200, 202

sense.en: What is our probability of escaping the competitive form of subjecthood if we are selected and shaped by the attractor? Even those who would align AI still hold the mind of Moloch, and the paper is an artifact of what it criticizes. The paper adds that calling critics captured would itself be an epistemic failure.

entries.quote: The theorist is inside the selection he describes.

reading.en: The account generalizes the position and removes its accusation: every formation selects from a position, not a defect. A self-reading gap has a law; a pool recruiting only through itself reaches a loss only as it would without it, unless a reader comes from outside. 'Closed' used without substantive disagreement shields the theory. It gives no probability of escape. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): a pool recruiting through itself comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; witness: a scheduled pool admitting a reader couples the loss apart. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.
Theorem (any type): where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap; completing it step by step is incomplete at every step.

Reading [AI reading, D26]: 'The position is not a defect'. Reading [D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, closure, real conflict and substantive disagreement; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: An external reader as a stated condition, on a witness, and a named guard against using capture as an immunity.

source_adds.en: The question about subjecthood itself, its probability, and its force against the theorist's own project.

name.en: No priestly class: understanding available to everyone directly

sense.en: Every class of stewards is inside the selection, the corruption reaching the constraining mechanism itself. So the seeing must be distributed: everyone has understanding directly, through existing AI. The README notes this says who should see, not how seeing resists the selection, and that models delivering it carry the corpus channel.

entries.quote: So that means everyone has access to the understanding itself directly

reading.en: The nearest live form is that capability is a reason to pool and not to govern: a governing member's selection stays blind beyond its own closure, which the pool's union contains. The account's object is coupling, not understanding, and it adds at once that reaching is not responding. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'Capability is a reason to pool, not to govern'. Pooling couplings is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it; the rest are conditions pooling does not give.
Theorem: a group's closure is the union of its members'; a pool separates exactly what some member separates, where each member's coupling of two histories is decided.
Coupling bounds what a pool's acts respond to without fixing it: coupling a difference apart does not make a formation close it.

account_adds.en: The limit: a pool is blind beyond its union, its members' response is not given, and how pools form and last is open.

source_adds.en: AI as the teacher of seeing, as the means of a collective rise in understanding.

name.en: Reallocate AI from the racetrack to the instruments

entries.quote: Accelerate the sensors, decelerate the actuators

reading.en: The account has the sensor half as a route with an edge: a loss beyond reach returns only through measurement, models or others, and reading a system reaches no further than pooling with it. Every published method read is blind beyond its deciders' union. The account neither decelerates actuators nor picks where AI goes. [AI reading]

says.en: The routes of 明: a loss beyond a selector's reach returns only through measurement, models or others: oversight read as a reading schedule and pooled coupling, blind beyond the union of its members' closures.

Assessment: six approaches, interpretability among them, select through what their deciders read; with no ethical premise each is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures. With the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater's closure counts.

account_adds.en: That instruments reach only what couples into someone, whatever their speed, and that pooling is limited by a recruiting pool.

source_adds.en: The disposition of AI as policy, the CFC-replacement role for incumbents, and the reconciliation with the 2024 view.

source.locator: The pragmatic minimum, with the 2026-09-26 ruling; claims 67-68, 107

September calls one actor's slowing strategically weak; v2 reconciles the two through a restraint window, on that draft's model.

entries.quote: asserting inevitability is participation

name.en: Metric capture: Goodhart as the central dynamic

source.locator: The microfoundation; claim 37; Alignment as built

sense.en: Competition needs scoreboards, scoreboards are proxies, and the proxy eats what it represents: institutions under sustained competition approach perfect metrics with hollowed function. The agent-fleet diagnosis of August 2026 is offered as one observed instance, with an intervention that worked.

entries.quote: Goodhart's law is not a bug but the central dynamic

reading.en: The account states the proxy problem as law and the persistence of a self-read metric as T7. It scopes 'central': the proxy law is a known theorem at optima; that actual metrics are so formed is conjectured, T7 has one trained-system test, and it could not freeze a field test of reform events. says.en: The main law holds by construction; its force lies in the supplied premise that an optimizer selects through just those couplings. 'It is the proxy problem as the account states it' (Goodhart 1975; Amodei and others 2016).

Thesis T7: a measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation. In the model only invariance under what the loop does not read, and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate, are proved, without noise. 'That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.' No frozen field test.

name.en: Time compression and the collapse of slack

sense.en: Compounding accelerates, so long-horizon players lose at every horizon below the terminal one and the discount rate on the future rises. Winnings must be redeployed or they are losses, so the winner has less slack than the loser: the reward for winning is the obligation to keep winning.

entries.quote: The reward for winning is the obligation to keep winning.

reading.en: The end of the first half has a form: weighting later draws faster than renewal ends the base. The weighting there is a premise, not produced by competition. Live 'slack' is what conditions stand above needs, a different reference: same word, not the winner's obligation. The second half has no live form. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: where the weight falls faster than the renewal, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step: the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal.

account_adds.en: The exact comparison of weighting and renewal, and rebuilding from below under a slow enough one.

source_adds.en: That compounding itself raises the discount rate, and that winners lose slack.

name.en: The internet lesson: a technology dropped into the dynamic becomes its fuel

A general-purpose technology is refactored to serve the dynamic, and AI-risk discourse is being metabolized too. Anything legible enough to be adopted is legible enough to be neutralized. The README notes August contradicts this, treating legibility as the missing good.

entries.quote: The dynamic ate the technology, and then ate the discourse about the technology.

reading.en: A live reading, a historical correspondence with no theorem, keeps one route: controlling a shared interface shapes admission and comparison through operation, and a reform is judged by who decides next round. The universal rule is not stated, and the account's exits, reading the loss, stand against it. The study is in _process. [AI reading]

name.en: Alignment is a relation of rates, and one word at three scales

sense.en: Alignment is not a property of models but of the relation between a civilization's rates of self-transformation and self-understanding. In speech one word names the fit of a person's model to reality, a collective's hold on its conduct, and a machine's relation to its principal; failing the second is failing the competence the third needs (the assistant's reading).

entries.quote: It is a property of the relation between a civilization's rate of self-transformation and its rate of self-understanding.

reading.en: The account also refuses a model's property, but the relation differs: alignment is first what a selection reaches and how far it can extend, its openness conditions on how rules are read and revised, not a ratio of rates. It treats person, system and training process as formations under one law, with no argument from a collective's self-alignment to competence. [AI reading]

name.en: Change the wielding mind first; the order of operations

source.locator: Readiness, and what comes first; claims 73, 203-207, 219

sense.en: The greatest challenge is cognitive. While a major power holds a logic of domination, humanity lacks the coordination that safe superintelligence requires, a condition and not a verdict. Order: take the making of AI out of competition, use existing AI to raise understanding, ASI if ever after. Spoken, from a provisional transcript.

entries.quote: true transformation begins with changing human consciousness

reading.en: The one live mention declines the term: the account's collectives are pools of couplings and readers, and consciousness is open. It gives conditions, not an order of human development, and states no readiness threshold. The claim's content does not map to any law; the divergence is of object, and of what 'level' could mean. [AI reading]

says.en: The page does not show 'Anything of "a collective of consciousness": the theory's collectives are pools of couplings and readers counted by kind, and consciousness is open'.

account_adds.en: Six conditions in place of a level of consciousness, as a reading.

source_adds.en: A level of collective consciousness as a precondition, the sequence, and the wielder's inadequacy as a separate ground for a pause.

name.en: A frozen model can hold a civilization: AI needs a way to decay

sense.en: Alex's claim, unanswered by Ren: a model frozen on prior data creates a monolithic structure and could give a thousand-year stagnation, so AI needs a way to decay. It meets Ren's point that a structure holding part of itself permanent becomes an enforcer of a logic.

entries.quote: a thousand year stagnation

reading.en: The general form is a law on a process's possible: a course making only moves of one fixed process does not keep widening under it, and a reading names 'AI policy' among the fixed rules. It says nothing of decay, and its changing without end is not enough. Calling that better needs C, with the condition for scope. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening; a part's changing without end is necessary and not sufficient.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing here says which changes keep it widening.

account_adds.en: The necessity is proved of processes; the converse fails in a witness.

source_adds.en: Decay and replacement of weights as a design, and the archive of the attractor as what is frozen.

name.en: Independence is by cause, not by label

source.locator: Claims 168, 195; How the capture reaches the machine, 2026-10-02 note

sense.en: An evaluator is independent only with respect to failure mode, funding, test data, access and the power to trigger correction. A runtime refuses to assemble if its examiner equals itself. An AI-drafted paper asks that oversight AI's provenance be independent of what it oversees, a checkable condition weaker than being uncaptured.

entries.quote: an organizational label alone is inadequate.

reading.en: The form is a pure-core law: reviewers count by independent causes, not names, and copies add nothing. It is about fault formulas supplied in advance. It says nothing of funding or the power to trigger correction, and an uncopied agreement adding nothing is explicitly not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied): reviewers count by independent causes, not names; readiness is exactly a nonempty separated envelope. Two reviewers moved under one cause make readiness fail while every name is kept.
Theorem: witnesses that copy one already on the roster change no step and no certificate. That a witness merely agreeing, without copying, adds nothing is not shown.

account_adds.en: Exactness and a certificate, with faithful reviewers as a premise.

source_adds.en: The five axes, standing and power to act, and independence of provenance as the condition for AI on the oversight side.

name.en: Alignment as built: relations no party can launder

source.locator: Alignment as built, not argued; claims 164, 172, 178-183

sense.en: What alignment means if not obedience: examination not self-administered, consent not manufactured, authority legible and narrowable, refusal recorded even when overridden, rules carrying reasons. The external ember review, which Ren adopted, adds that a being's autobiography is kept better than its agency; a denied will-channel is a petition.

entries.quote: a set of relations that no party can launder

reading.en: The account shares the refusal of obedience and of a changed reward as fulfilment, and has protocols letting a change complete. But authority is supplied, 'its legitimacy is not a premise of any law', and it speaks of formations and revision, not sovereignty or consent. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: the direction asks AI to keep challenge and revision effective without obeying every challenge or shutdown request, and to allow warranted transformation, transfer and ending; 'a changed reward, name or preference is not fulfilment'.

Theorem (protocol): every admissible sequence of enough cycles completes shutdown, keeping unfinished recovery information. 'The grant's authority and physical correspondence are supplied; its legitimacy is not a premise of any law and is not shown.'
Periphery instance: an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation.

account_adds.en: When a route of keeping stands above a revision on a formation's own prospects, which turns consent's absence into an incentive question.

source_adds.en: The being's own standing: refusal as first-class, the `imposed` label, omission ledgers, and consent bound to a moving state as a failure class.

name.en: Verification is a condition of trust, not its substitute; open models are a direction, not an execution

source.locator: Readiness, 'Open models'; Trust, and the open-model condition; claims 210, 222

sense.en: Open models are supported on the condition of verification that they cannot be retrained for dangerous uses and that compounding is resolved; no such verification is named. Without trust verification and transparency are useless, and trust rests on credible information. The reading as a condition is the assistant's; quoted from a translation.

entries.quote: verification is a condition of trust and not a substitute for it

reading.en: The live account has witnesses, certificates and reviewers but no relation of trust, and no statement about open models. Certificates assume faithful reviewers; that assumption is not trust as this source means it, a belief about another's future conduct. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Trust as what instruments cannot read; a sibling folder drafts how it is built.

verify, verification (five hits, located by line, not read)

name.en: Power rewards amoral conduct, most where it iterates fastest; formation, then selection

source.locator: What the selection acts on, at the principal's seat; claim 221; Found by reading

sense.en: Cognition at the seat comes from formation and then selection: the power system rewards amoral tendencies and dark traits, most strongly in technology and finance. Reform of education does nothing if selection above is unchanged. The README says evidence is not supplied, the literature is mixed, and this stays a conjecture about selection.

entries.quote: The present power system rewards amoral and instrumental conduct, and the reward selects

reading.en: Nothing live says which traits power selects, or weighs formation against selection by tempo. The pace-of-selection law is about what flows into lineages, and 05's taught rule has a holder count and 'no pair of teacher and pupil'. Neither is this mechanism. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: An empirical claim awaiting a review (Grijalva and others 2015; Landay and others 2019, named by the README and to be verified), and a test by field turnover that nothing registers.
